text.text: Most retention tools talk at students. Journey helps you listen to them.
The right message at the right moment. At UNH, 74% of first-years write back, and at-risk retention went from 50% to 94%.
Journey is like a friend that texts first.
Ask it when you need something. It also knows when to check in.
Works inside the platforms you already use.
No app to install. No new password. No fight with IT. Journey is the glue, it gets your students to the resources you already invest in.
Nudges for whatever they’re working on.
Stories from the cohort.
Discover how Journey helps students and the team supporting them.
Built on the science of the nudge.
“Nudge” comes from the behavioral economics of Richard Thaler and Cass Sunstein, who showed that the structure of a choice moves behavior more than information or willpower ever do.
Choice architecture
Thaler & Sunstein, 2008. Structure the moment, not the sermon. One tap takes a student from “I’m overwhelmed” to a booked appointment.
Just-in-time adaptive intervention
The right nudge in the right window, capped at a few per week. Attention gets respected, not captured.
Tinto’s persistence research
Every check-in maps to the four drivers of whether a student stays: financial, academic, wellness, and engagement.
What students say.
“5 minutes with Journey helps me with my entire week. It let me do things I’d never done before, be more social with people in person.”
“Joined NAACP, Animation Club, and Theater auditions. I went from 0 clubs to 4 in a month.”

“Journey help me doing things I already wanted to do.”
